layouts.name: Bruntingthorpe
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Independently mapped shorter airfield loop follows the Northeastern runway turnaround, the intermediate Southern taxiway return and the Western rounded turn. This physical course excludes the full Northern proving-ground perimeter and extra runway crossings. Exact source nodes measure 3714.5 m against the historical catalogue scalar of 2944 m; they are retained without scaling. The council identifies the airfield as a vehicle proving ground with flexible runway and circuit use. Temporary cone cuts, lap extent, direction and historical alignment remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3714.5 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

layouts.name: Bruntingthorpe Combo
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Bruntingthorpe, Bruntingthorpe Full. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Bruntingthorpe Full
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The full airfield circuit follows the long northern runway leg and southern perimeter with the central projecting return. Independently mapped runway and taxiway centrelines form an exact source cycle of 6691.8 m. The local council describes the proving-ground circuit as 6.5 km, while the supplied historical catalogue declares 7069 m. This draft retains the independently mapped course, documents that discrepancy and excludes the intermediate runway shortcut; historical alignment remains provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 6691.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The combined airfield entry preserves the independently mapped shorter runway loop and full proving-ground course as separate component paths. Both recipes pin consistent way versions from the same source snapshot. Shared edges count once, no new connector is drawn and no unique network distance is presented as a single race lap. The council identifies the proving-ground circuit and long runway. Short-course historical timing extent and temporary cone cuts remain unverified. The independent unique branch distance is 7042.3 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
